name: polkadot-daily-digest-devnet
description: Devnet deployment tooling for the Polkadot Daily Digest. Isolated from the production site - see devnet/README.md.
overridesReason: @novasamatech/host-papp declares polkadot-api '>=2' but imports 'polkadot-api/signer', an export dropped in 3.0.0. Left unpinned, npm resolves 3.x and `pad` dies at startup with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. 2.2.2 is the newest release that still provides it. Drop this override once host-papp tightens its range.
